topic: Free buses cut Hyderabad women's trip co
hook: Free buses cut Hyderabad women's trip cost from ₹30.4 to *₹9.7*
hook_b: Did free buses change how Hyderabad women travel? A study says *yes*
tldr: An SPA study of 410 women in GHMC finds Mahalakshmi cut average trip cost by 68.1%.

beats.what: A School of Planning and Architecture study measured Mahalakshmi's impact on women's travel.
beats.why: Free TGSRTC travel for women began in Dec 2023; researchers checked if it improved mobility.
beats.care: Women save most on fares; researchers say peripheral routes and last-mile links still lag.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Researchers from SPA Vijayawada and SPA New Delhi surveyed 410 women across GHMC; 49% were students. Average cost per trip fell from ₹30.4 to ₹9.7. Bus as main mode rose from 43.8% to 71.2%. Weekly trips moved from 4.23 to 4.35, which was not statistically significant. Households earning under ₹20,000 a month saved about 73%. The study recommends more buses in peripheral and low-income areas, better first- and last-mile links and extra buses during college hours.

cards.q: How good are TGSRTC buses on your route?
Which group saved the most on travel, per the study?
cards.why: Lower-income households saw costs fall about 73%, versus 62% for those above ₹2 lakh.

viz.verdict: Women pay far less per trip

viz.l: Women using buses as main mode

cover.label: cut in women's cost per trip

insight: Women's main use of TGSRTC buses jumped from 43.8% to 71.2%, but weekly trips barely changed.
